description: List what this workspace has already published to its social channels, newest first: per post the exact text each channel got (hashtags included), the channel, permalink, publishedAt, title, contentPostId and productId, plus per channel the publishing rhythm (lastPostedAt, postsLast7Days, postsLast30Days, medianGapHours, nextScheduledAt, scheduledCount) and, in sources, the channel's public address (profileUrl, publicFeedUrl) with a note. Only posts published through Obriym are listed. Posts typed directly into the network are not stored here — before planning, compare against BOTH this list and the channel itself: open sources[].publicFeedUrl or profileUrl with your own browsing to read everything posted there (a public Telegram channel reads at t.me/s/<name>; LinkedIn and Instagram may need a login; a Viber channel is read in the Viber app; a private channel cannot be read from outside). Never claim the channel had no other posts, and say so when a channel cannot be read. Use it before planning or writing new posts: avoid repeating a topic, product or phrasing, and use the rhythm to choose dates that keep a steady flow; then create_content_post and schedule_content_post. Filter by channel or by days (YYYY-MM-DD on the workspace's clock), 20 per page. Read-only. Use list_content_posts for drafts and scheduled posts, get_content_post for one post's per-channel results.

channel.description: Only this network's posts: instagram, facebook, telegram, linkedin, threads or viber. Omit for all channels.

from.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar day on the workspace's clock. Omit for no lower bound.

page.description: Page number, newest posts first. Default 1.

to.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the workspace's clock. Omit for no upper bound.

name: list_published_posts
title: List published posts
